title: Architectural Risk Matrix
purpose: Map 14 identified security and operational risks across a 3x3 Impact x Likelihood grid, annotated with mitigation status and source file paths.
audience: Security engineers, architects, engineering leads, CTO, risk management
description: Architectural risk matrix with 3x3 Impact x Likelihood grid. Critical zone (High Impact x High Likelihood): sandbox 0x0000 bypass, missing fan route guard, memory exhaustion — none mitigated. High zone (High x Medium and Medium x High): no Stripe webhooks, no DB transactions, dynamic require(), unprotected referral routes, JWT_SECRET in frontend, duplicate AppError classes — no mitigation. Medium zone (Medium x Medium): sync fs.appendFileSync, mocked off-ramp, no Redis/ElastiCache — none or partial mitigation. Low zone (Low x Medium): dead Stripe endpoints, CSS blur bypass — no or partial mitigation. No risks appear in Low x Low or Low x High cells.
preconditions: Risk assessment has been completed based on codebase analysis in 07-cross-cutting-concerns.md
postconditions: 14 risks are mapped to Impact x Likelihood cells with mitigation status
Critical risks requiring immediate action are identified

nodes.label: 1. 0x0000 sandbox bypass — Status: None
nodes.description: High x High: Fake txHash bypasses on-chain verification — no mitigation

nodes.label: 2. Missing fan route guard — Status: None
nodes.description: High x High: /fan/* routes accessible without auth — no mitigation

nodes.label: 3. Memory exhaustion (1GB buffer) — Status: Partial
nodes.description: High x High: Multer 1GB limit + sync processing — partial mitigation (multer limit)

nodes.label: 4. No Stripe webhooks — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: High x Medium: No Stripe webhook handling leads to payment drift

nodes.label: 5. No DB transactions — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: High x Medium: No atomic DB operations — partial updates on failure

nodes.label: 6. Dynamic require() — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: High x Medium: Dynamic require in support.service.ts — injection risk

nodes.label: 7. Unprotected referral routes — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: Medium x High: 2 referral routes lack protect middleware

nodes.label: 8. JWT_SECRET in frontend — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: Medium x High: Server secret exposed to client bundle

nodes.label: 9. Duplicate AppError classes — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: Medium x High: Two identical AppError classes — maintenance risk

nodes.label: 10. Sync fs.appendFileSync — Status: None
nodes.description: Medium x Medium: Synchronous file IO in auth middleware

nodes.label: 11. Mocked off-ramp — Status: None
nodes.description: Medium x Medium: Payout off-ramp is fully mocked

nodes.label: 12. No Redis/ElastiCache — Status: Partial
nodes.description: Medium x Medium: No caching layer

nodes.label: 13. Dead Stripe endpoints — Status: No mitigation
nodes.description: Low x Medium: Frontend calls /payments/* that return 404

nodes.label: 14. CSS blur bypass — Status: Partial
nodes.description: Low x Medium: CSS blur for locked content is trivially bypassable

businessRules: Critical zone (High x High): immediate remediation required
High zone (High x Medium, Medium x High): remediate in current sprint
Medium zone (Medium x Medium): remediate in next sprint
Low zone (Low x Medium): remediate when convenient
securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: Sandbox 0x0000 bypass allows fake payments without blockchain verification
CRITICAL: Missing fan route guard exposes fan UI to all users
CRITICAL: Memory exhaustion risk from 1GB buffer per file upload
HIGH: No Stripe webhooks means payment status drift between Stripe and DB
HIGH: No DB transactions means partial updates on failure can corrupt data
performanceConsiderations: Synchronous appendFileSync blocks Node.js event loop
No Redis/ElastiCache means repeated queries hit PostgreSQL directly
1GB memory buffer per file upload can exhaust available RAM
annotations: Critical zone (High x High): sandbox bypass, missing fan guard, memory exhaustion
High zone (High x Medium and Medium x High): 6 risks across payment, DB, secrets, routes
Medium zone: sync logging, mocked off-ramp, no caching
Low zone: dead Stripe endpoints, CSS blur bypass
No risks in Low x Low or Low x High cells

legend.meaning: High risk (High x Medium, Medium x High)
